subject: maths
question: A rectangular pond 30 m wide and 90 m long is surrounded by a walkway of equal width. If the total area of ​​the walkway is 2800 m², what will be the width (in meter) of the walkway?
solution:
**Formula:**

A = L × B, where

A = Area of rectangle

L = Length of the rectangle

B = Breadth of the rectangle

**Calculation:**

From the figure, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33e7cc9f7bbf722b43438072d29932a91a9210d0e986db7ae8f04072fdbbfb93.png] 

Area of pool = 90 m × 30 m = 2700 m²

Let the width of the walkway be "a" m.

Length of walkway = 90 + a + a = (90 + 2a) m

Breadth of walkway = 30 + a + a = (30 + 2a) m

Area of complete figure = (90 + 2a) × (30 + 2a)

According to the figure -

Area of pool + Area of pathway = Area of complete figure
